name: effect-fence-client-error-omitted-content-hash-400
description: The second half of the 'each missing field is named distinctly' contract. content_hash is REQUIRED on this route, unlike on pre-read where the caller may not have it yet: without the caller's own digest the generation demotion can never fire and the fence silently loses the one leg that catches a decision derived from superseded bytes (the leg 10 exercises). The error names content_hash rather than expected_generation, so a diff that collapsed the two validation messages into one phrase turns this fixture red against 11.
